[![RobertHeath](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/7/7a/RobertHeath.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/200?cb=20211012221139)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/7/7a/RobertHeath.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20211012221139)
**Robert Heath** is a designer who worked at Hot Wheels from 2013 to 2020. Prior to his work at Mattel, he was a designer at competing brand Spin Master and at Disney Consumer Products. He is currently managing his own design firm, Pencil Dog Creations.
